page.title: AI observability
page.description: The collection summary, ingest health and export status of every Bot in your management scope.

disabled.title: Observability is off
disabled.description: The integration is disabled, so there is nothing to collect. This is a configuration state, not a fault.

empty.title: Nothing in scope
empty.description: No runs or experiments match this filter inside your authorized scope.

forbidden.title: Outside your scope
forbidden.description: Your administrative role does not cover this data. Scope is resolved before any aggregation, never after.

basic.title: Basic coverage only
basic.description: These records hold only what OpenBot observed. A basic record is not a healthy detailed record.

omitted.title: Content omitted
omitted.description: This field could not be handled safely, so only metrics are shown.

truncated.title: Content truncated
truncated.description: This value exceeds the recorded size limit and was cut.

syncing.title: Ingest lagging
syncing.description: Records are arriving later than the runs that produced them. Lag is visible here rather than shown as missing traffic.

unavailable.title: Upstream unavailable
unavailable.description: The observability store did not answer. Normal Agent execution continued unaffected; drops and faults are reported here.

ready.title: Collection healthy
ready.description: The observability store is answering and accepting writes.

disabled.title: Observability is off
disabled.description: The integration is disabled, so nothing is being collected. This is a configuration state, not a fault.

unconfigured.title: Observability is unconfigured
unconfigured.description: No upstream location is configured, so nothing is being collected. This is a configuration state, not a fault.

capability_missing.title: No verified upstream contract
capability_missing.description: This deployment has no verified Opik contract to collect through. This is a capability gap, not a fault.

authentication_failure.title: Upstream rejected the credentials
authentication_failure.description: The observability store answered but refused this deployment's credentials, so collection is failing.

unreachable.title: Upstream unavailable
unreachable.description: The observability store did not answer. Normal Agent runs continued unaffected; the local counts below still answer.

summary.scopeNote: Scope is resolved one Bot at a time before anything is counted, so a full-range answer takes a moment — and never widens to Bots outside your management role.
summary.truncatedDescription: This answer covers the first {{count}} Bots in your management scope.
summary.retention: Run records are kept for 7 days, datasets and experiments for 30 days, unless your deployment configures longer retention.
summary.upstreamWindow: Unbound-trace and usage counts come from the store's most recent 100-trace window, not from the time filter; every local count honors the filter.
summary.dropped: Dropped writes: {{queueFull}} queue full · {{notReady}} not ready

page.title: Run exports
page.description: The export jobs of this Bot and the file each finished job produced.

empty.title: No exports yet
empty.description: An export packages this Bot's recorded runs into a downloadable file; none has been requested.

errorCodes.CAPABILITY_MISSING: The integration is not enabled for this deployment.
errorCodes.EXPORT_ROW_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The export exceeded the deployment's row limit and was refused rather than truncated.
errorCodes.OPIK_TIMEOUT: The observability store was too slow to answer.
errorCodes.OPIK_UNREACHABLE: The observability store did not answer.
errorCodes.OPIK_UPSTREAM_ERROR: The observability store reported an upstream error.
errorCodes.OPIK_CLIENT_ERROR: The export request was refused by the store.
errorCodes.OPIK_MALFORMED_RESPONSE: The store's answer could not be trusted.
errorCodes.OPIK_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT: Ownership changed while the export ran.
